title: Matched opening decision diagnostic: Round430 vs Round574
method: 128 fresh team-pair clusters, side-swapped, one repeat; traces summarize the checkpoint's first decision and resulting turn state.

round430.interpretation_limit: Associational only: team selection, lead matchup, move legality, hidden sets, and chance outcomes confound action/result comparisons. Protect availability does not imply that Protect was the best action.

round574.interpretation_limit: Associational only: team selection, lead matchup, move legality, hidden sets, and chance outcomes confound action/result comparisons. Protect availability does not imply that Protect was the best action.

finding: The low Max Damage score is present in both checkpoints; doubling PPO passes did not resolve it. Early active-Pokemon knockouts are associated with worse match outcomes, while protective moves are rarely selected even when available. These data identify an opening-survival diagnostic target, not a proven action fix.
